summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing daily purchases under its buy-back programme launched 5 August 2026. On 23 September 2026 it bought 3,350,605 ordinary shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average of £15.1877 and 525,600 shares in Hong Kong at HK$158.4112, all for cancellation via BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC. Cumulative repurchases since commencement total 46,023,902 shares for approximately US$945.0m. Issued ordinary share capital now stands at 17,141,942,291 shares with no treasury shares. Watch the pace of daily executions, Hong Kong cancellation lag, and whether the programme signals further capital-return announcements.
